description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the AutoRetireUsersTask in the OpenMRS project, verifying user retirement logic based on inactivity periods, user roles, and user status.

classes.name: AutoRetireUsersTaskTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AutoRetireUsersTask, testing user retirement logic based on inactivity and other user properties.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and dependencies before each test.

methods.name: shouldRetireUsersWhoseInactivityExceedNumberOfDaysToRetire
methods.description: Verifies that users inactive beyond the configured inactivity days are retired.

methods.name: shouldNotRetireUsersWhoseInactivityDoNotExceedNumberOfDaysToRetire
methods.description: Ensures that users inactive less than the threshold are not retired.

methods.name: shouldNotRetireAlreadyRetiredUsers
methods.description: Checks that already retired users are not processed for retirement again.

methods.name: shouldNotRetireUsersThatAreInactiveSinceCreationAndInactivityDoesNotExceedNumberOfDaysToRetire
methods.description: Confirms that newly created users inactive less than the threshold are not retired.

methods.name: shouldRetireUsersThatAreInactiveSinceCreationAndInactivityExceedsNumberOfDaysToRetire
methods.description: Checks that newly created users inactive beyond the threshold are retired.

methods.name: shouldNotRetireSuperUsers
methods.description: Verifies that super users are excluded from retirement.

methods.name: getDefaultUser
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a default test user.
